title: Demographics Profiling Dashboard
subtitle: Large-Scale National Analytics · PostgreSQL & FastAPI
summary: High-throughput national demographics analytics platform serving 22M+ records with sub-300ms API latency and rapid AI data filtering.

tradeoff.bottleneck: Unindexed queries and heavy API payloads stalled demographic breakdowns across 22M+ national records.
tradeoff.decision: Engineered composite PostgreSQL indexes and stripped extraneous serialization fields — cutting SQL query time by 40% and achieving sub-300ms API latency.

highlights: Migrated and indexed a schema of over 22M national records in PostgreSQL to power large-scale analytics.
Engineered FastAPI REST endpoints to serve complex data breakdowns with sub-300ms latency.
Optimized backend processes by stripping extraneous features and improved SQL query performance by 40%.
Built backend logic for AI data filtering, extracting targeted subsets from 22M records in <2 seconds.

title: Plan-AI Hackathon 2026
subtitle: Geospatial RAG & Urban Sprawl Forecasting
summary: End-to-end geospatial intelligence pipeline combining satellite imagery, local 32B LLM legal auditing, and predictive 2030 urban sprawl forecasts.

tradeoff.bottleneck: Manual legal auditing of satellite land-use data could not scale or project long-horizon urban sprawl.
tradeoff.decision: Coupled Sentinel-2 and OSM spatial pipelines with a local 32B-parameter LLM over ChromaDB RAG to autonomously audit compliance and forecast 2030 sprawl.

highlights: Engineered a Python pipeline processing Sentinel-2 imagery and live OSM APIs to compute ecological metrics.
Built a ChromaDB RAG system integrating a 32B-parameter local LLM to autonomously audit spatial legal compliance.
Architected automated JSON reports and predictive 2030 urban sprawl forecasts delivered to a React dashboard.

title: AI Chatbot (RAG)
subtitle: Gemini-Powered Natural Language BI Assistant
summary: Enterprise conversational analytics assistant enabling stakeholders to query complex databases and generate visual insights with zero hallucinations.

tradeoff.bottleneck: Direct LLM querying across normalized relational schemas caused join hallucinations and hours of manual verification.
tradeoff.decision: Denormalized target tables into deterministic context views for Gemini RAG — guaranteeing 100% data integrity and shrinking retrieval from hours to seconds.

highlights: Developed a Gemini-powered AI virtual assistant for stakeholders to query complex databases and generate visual insights using natural language.
Conducted data denormalization to structure raw context and eliminate AI hallucinations with 100% data integrity.
Reduced executive data retrieval and reporting time from hours to mere seconds.

title: Banci Ekonomi (BE) Publication Automation
subtitle: Statistical Publication Pipeline · DOSM
summary: Automated multi-stage statistical publication pipeline that compressed multi-day manual data workflows into minutes with 100% statistical accuracy.

tradeoff.bottleneck: Multi-day manual spreadsheet cleaning and cross-tabulation risked human error across national economic census tables.
tradeoff.decision: Automated end-to-end cleaning, validation, and aggregation in Python/Pandas — slashing processing time by 90% while preserving 100% of statistical totals.

highlights: Led automation of a multi-stage statistical publication pipeline including cleaning, validation, and aggregation.
Slashed publication processing time by up to 90%.
Transformed multi-day manual tasks into minutes while preserving 100% of statistical totals.

title: Datathon 2025 Judging System (MDIT x DOSM)
subtitle: Real-Time Concurrent Evaluation & Leaderboard Platform
summary: Concurrency-safe real-time scoring architecture synchronizing multi-judge evaluations into an instant, race-condition-free live leaderboard.

tradeoff.bottleneck: Simultaneous score submissions from multiple judges caused database write collisions and stale leaderboard states.
tradeoff.decision: Enforced mutex serialization via LockService around atomic score tabulation — eliminating race conditions for an instant, zero-error live leaderboard.

highlights: Served as Lead Developer in architecting a real-time scoring system for MDIT x DOSM.
Engineered pipelines to process concurrent evaluations from multiple judges, ensuring seamless real-time data synchronization.
Utilized LockService to prevent database race conditions, completely automating score tabulation to deliver an instant, error-free leaderboard.
